title: Auto-Generation Of Properties: Methodology Insertion
gist: AI can generate SystemVerilog assertions in seconds, but poor or missing chip specifications, vacuous properties and SMT compute costs limit the value of auto-generated formal properties today. Experts from Synopsys, Axiomise, Cadence, Arteris, Normal Computing and Southampton argue the technology increases rather than reduces the need for formal-literate engineers, and that adoption methodology and governance lag the tooling.
